title: "Mi Amigo Machito" and "El As de la Rumba"
summary: Rene Hernandez arranged "El As de la Rumba," a Silvestre Mendez piece, for the 1959 album.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: "Afro-Cuban Suite" and "Kenya" are the best Afro-Cuban jazz album the Machito orchestra has recorded, you know. Ahh - 1959, you made "Mi Amigo Machito" and you made "La Feria de las Flores - A night with Machito", but on the "Mi Amigo Machito", you have "Israeli", I think, "Cha-Cha" ...
... but you have "El As de la Rumba", How did you come by that number?
Well, that number is a Cuban composition, by a Cuban composer.
Yes, Silvestre Mendez; so we found a piano part and we give it to Renee and Renee made the arrangement and we recorded it.
